narrative.overview:
Courrier is an Operate workspace for personal mail: people move between dedicated mailbox pages, screen unfamiliar senders, and read each conversation on its own route. The approved identity is IMPECCABLE’S PICK — Papeterie numérique. Warm light, fine rules, a single open sans family, and restrained ink-teal cues make the interface feel like a quiet digital writing desk without literal paper decoration.

A mailbox stays a single chronological list with flat rows. Opening a thread replaces the list with one centered reading column; the full-screen composer remains a focused writing workspace, with its existing popup and minimized modes. Light and dark themes keep the same hierarchy while using theme-specific values.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, low-chroma surfaces with fine separators.
DM Sans Variable supplies the entire interface hierarchy.
Chronological mailbox rows stay flat; an open thread gets its own reading surface.
Muted teal marks primary action, selection, and focus; status colors stay semantic.

rules.name: The One Reader Rule
rules.body: A mailbox route shows its chronological list; opening a thread replaces it with a focused reader route.

rules.name: The Functional Depth Rule
rules.body: Let tonal changes and fine rules do most of the grouping; reserve shadows for menus, popovers, dialogs, and floating controls that need separation.

dos: Do build mailbox pages as one chronological list with flat rows and fine dividers.
Do keep each open thread on its own reading route in a centered 816px maximum sheet.
Do use DM Sans Variable for interface and message content, with size and weight for hierarchy.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and respect reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't add paper textures, fake postage, or decorative stationery to suggest paper.
Don't keep a persistent message list beside an open thread or wrap ordinary mail rows in nested cards.
Don't use glass blur on the reader action dock.
Don't introduce a second display font or use semantic red and blue as brand accents.
